# Contract: C and C++ ABI

What a C or C++ user compiles against. Generated per build by `kmr_api::ffi::build`
([rust-surface.md](rust-surface.md)); never hand-edited. Layout proved in
[research.md](../research.md) R1. Types in [data-model.md](../data-model.md).

## `kmr_ffi.h` (C11)

```c
/* generated by kmr_ffi, do not edit */
#include <stdint.h>
#define KMR_N 4                 /* robot!'s N for this build */
#define KMR_HISTORY_DEPTH 4

#define KMR_AGE_NONE UINT32_MAX /* actuator never read */

typedef struct { uint64_t stale, bus_error, offline, rejected, joint_limit, envelope; } kmr_actuator_flags;
typedef struct {
    float q[KMR_N]; float qd[KMR_N]; float tau[KMR_N];   /* one line per field */
    kmr_actuator_flags flags;                            /* one bit per actuator */
    uint32_t tick_flags; uint32_t reserved;
} kmr_slot;
typedef struct {
    uint32_t samples; uint32_t reserved;
    uint32_t age[KMR_N];          /* latest slot only: ticks since actuator i was read */
    kmr_slot slot[KMR_HISTORY_DEPTH];
} kmr_read_view;
typedef struct { uint64_t q, qd, tau; } kmr_written;
typedef struct { float q[KMR_N]; float qd[KMR_N]; float tau[KMR_N]; kmr_written written; } kmr_write_buf;
typedef struct { uint64_t tick, dt_ns, elapsed_ns, overrun_count, last_overrun_ns,
                 accumulated_overrun_ns; } kmr_time_view;

static inline void kmr_set_q(kmr_write_buf *w, unsigned i, float v);   /* one per field */
enum { KMR_CONTINUE = 0, KMR_SHUTDOWN = 1, KMR_EMERGENCY_STOP = 2 };
```

`kmr_set_<field>` stores the value and sets bit i of `written.<field>`; `i >= KMR_N` is ignored.

`age` is per actuator, for the latest slot only (depth 0): the core gives `Option<u32>` per
actuator, not an age per History slot. `KMR_AGE_NONE` is the core's `None`. `envelope` is per
actuator, like the core's `Faults<N>` and kmr_api's `Faults` view (D3 A, assumed, pending
human).

## The foreign function

```c
int32_t name(const kmr_read_view *in, kmr_write_buf *out, const kmr_time_view *time, void *ctx);
```

| Rule | Source |
|---|---|
| `in`, `out`, `time` are valid for the call only; never keep them | FR-006 (SRS FR-10.2) |
| `out` is zeroed before the call | FR-011 (SRS FR-2.5) |
| `ctx` is the controller's context, or `NULL` for a context-free controller | US1 scenario 5 |
| Return a status (0, 1, 2) or a negative error code | FR-023, FR-012 |
| On an error, nothing in `out` is applied | FR-012 (SRS FR-2.5) |
| `in->samples == 0`: no sample exists; do not read `slot` | core FR-018 |
| Only flagged entries are sent; an unwritten actuator gets no command | FR-011 (SRS FR-2.5) |
| A crash or abort leaves torque as it was | FR-025 (SRS NFR-2) |
| Slow, allocating or blocking code is allowed; overruns are counted | FR-005 (SRS FR-10.3) |

## `kmr_ffi.hpp` (C++17)

Includes `kmr_ffi.h`. Generated from the same field list.

```cpp
namespace kmr {
struct Q { float v; }; struct Qd { float v; }; struct Tau { float v; };   // one per field
class In  { public: Q q(std::size_t depth, std::size_t i) const; /* qd, tau, stale(..); age(i), depth 0 only */ };
class Out { public: void set(std::size_t i, Q v); /* one overload per field */ };
}
#define KMR_CPP_CONTROLLER(name, body)   /* extern "C" name(..) noexcept { try { return body(..); } catch (...) { return -100; } } */
```

- `static_assert(sizeof(Q) == sizeof(float))`, standard layout, trivially copyable.
- Accessors are inline; no cost over the C types (FR-016 (SRS FR-10.1)).
- No exception crosses: any exception returns `-100` (FR-016, FR-022 (SRS NFR-2)).

## N check

`build.rs` compiles the C/C++ sources against this header and writes `KMR_N` into
`OUT_DIR/kmr_ffi_abi.rs`. `foreign!` in `main.rs` asserts it equals `robot!`'s N. A mismatch is
`error[E0080]: ... kmr_ffi: C sources were built for another N` under `cargo check`
(FR-015, SC-005 (SRS FR-6.1, FR-10.2)). D12 A; [research.md](../research.md) R4.
